h1: Our Office Location in Lalitpur, Nepal
directAnswer: Lalitpur Financial Advisory is centrally situated in the Pulchowk-Kumaripati commercial corridor of Lalitpur Metropolitan City, Bagmati Province, Nepal. The office is easily accessible from Patan, Jawalakhel, and downtown Kathmandu, serving commercial and private clients nationwide.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Operations

sections.contentHtml:
Physical Address: Level 3, Apex Commercial Complex, Pulchowk-Kumaripati Main Road, Lalitpur Metropolitan City, Ward No. 5, Bagmati Province, Postal Code 44700, Nepal. (Centrally located in Lalitpur's primary financial and corporate corridor).

Landmarks: Situated between Pulchowk Engineering Campus and Kumaripati commercial center, close to major commercial banking branches (Nabil, NIC Asia, Himalayan Bank).

While our physical headquarters is located in Lalitpur, over 60% of our SME advisory clients operate across Koshi, Madhesh, Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali, and Sudurpashchim provinces via secure cloud-accounting and digital conferencing.

cta.subtext: Contact our desk to arrange an office appointment with our senior advisory team.
